verdict: A near-faithful Wikipedia Main Page with every block, photo and link present; the gap is a substitute sans (Arimo instead of the reference's Helvetica) plus 1–3 px vertical drifts, and it is a reasonably editable auto-layout build with four components but no shared styles.

top_defects.what: set in Arimo (Arial metrics) instead of the reference's Helvetica: different glyphs (R, G, a, t) on every line, the main source of the text-edge differences in the heatmap; welcome title 25.6 px instead of 25.92 px
rows drift down progressively: Small +1 CSS px, Standard (Width) +2 px, Light +3 px vs the reference (section labels 36/41 px tall instead of a consistent rhythm)

top_defects.where: In the news list and Kimi Antonelli photo
top_defects.what: list items 1–2 CSS px lower than the reference while the photo is about 2 px shorter and its caption 1–2 px higher; heatmap grid cells at bottom right reach meanDiff 20
magnifier drawn darker grey than the reference's mid grey (#72777d-like), hamburger bars slightly heavier/darker
no text or color styles/variables (styled: 0); raw values such as 19.200000762939453px, 15.199999809265137px and fractional gaps 8.5/10.5/11.5 repeated per frame

inactive tab instances keep a 67×2 'Indicator' rectangle (hidden leftover, width of 'Main Page'), a gap:-1 overlap hack in the search bar, and the Page tabs bar itself is not auto-layout (Namespaces, Views, watchstar pulse positioned absolutely)
wordmark and tagline sit about 1 CSS px higher than the reference

strengths: Content is complete and exact: every link, count (265,650 / 7,260,752), diacritic (Święczkowski, Bartłomiej Sochański), bold/italic run and the blue watchstar dot are present
Column, banner and section-heading surfaces match the measured colors (#f5fffa/#cef2e0, #f5faff/#cedff2, #f9f9f9) and box sizes (502×36, 590×36)
Structure is named and mostly auto-layout, with real components for tabs, radio options, section headings and list items (20 instances)
